description: Public domain works from the lyric-free classical pieces in MCUD 1.0. Each work lists the MCUD song IDs whose valence and arousal it takes (averaged) and the search used to find freely licensed recordings. Pieces under copyright (Giazotto's Adagio attributed to Albinoni, Gorecki, Kreisler, Seymer, Yanni and modern Chinese compositions) and entries whose composer or movement is ambiguous are left out.
